newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent ends up following firm lead on ACCESS.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent ends up following firm lead on ACCESS.

text.p: Brent crude futures rose on Monday supported by follow through buying from a sharp rally on Friday.
January Brent, which expires later on Monday, ended one cent higher on SIMEX at $23.54 per barrel, compared with London's settlement on Friday.
Brokers said February ended 11 cents higher at $23.01.
Brokers said NYMEX was firmer throughout the day which gave the SIMEX market a stronger tone in the absence of fresh factors from Friday.
Both Brent and NYMEX rose sharply on Friday, supported by worries of cold weather in the northern hemisphere.
Brokers said a growing row between Iran and the United States over responsibility for a bomb attack that killed U.S. servicemen in June had not been a talking point in the market.
Over the weekend, Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei said in a speech broadcast live over radio that the U.S. had decided to strike against Iraq.
Last week, President Clinton said he had not concluded who was responsible for the bombing.
